messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT P1 — Obsidian Corp (VPC, dedicated pool obsidian-dp-01) experiencing elevated 5xx + truncated responses for model obsidian-gpt. Pager: @maria (oncall). Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INF-7821 :rotating_light:

maria (oncall): On it. Pulling dashboards and logs now. Will triage root cause and coordinate mitigation.

dylan (SRE): I'm seeing repeated worker restarts on obsidian-dp-01 around the time of the spike. Eviction counters jump, KV cache misses up 10x. Routing attempts to fallback to safe variants are hitting compatibility errors.

sameer (ml-infra): Quick hypothesis: the recent quantization kernel update (kq2) seems to cause a memory regression under certain sequence lengths — leads to oom/evictions on dedicated pools with mixed batch sizes. Recommend immediate fallback to the known-good safe variant v3.2-safe for this tenant.

leah (SE): I'll prep a customer note. Message draft: "We're enabling a safe fallback (v3.2-safe) for your model to restore stability while we investigate. This is non-destructive; no data reingestion needed. We'll update with ETA for a permanent fix." Approve?

maria (oncall): Approve. Prioritize restoring availability.

dylan (SRE): Executing manual routing + pin to safe variant and enabling c-breaker thresholds for this tenant. Commands run: 
```
redwoodctl route set --tenant obsidian --model obsidian-gpt:v3.2-safe --pin
redwoodctl config set --tenant obsidian --circuit-breaker "5xx=0.05,latency=2000ms"
```
Applied at 4456789017.

maria (oncall): Changes applied, verifying metrics. Error rate down ~65% in the last 30s, p95 latency stable.

incident-bot: Ticket INF-7821 created and linked. Reminder: add mitigation timeline and affected customer callbacks.

sameer (ml-infra): We'll schedule a rollback of the kq2 kernel for the obsidian dedicated pool during the low-traffic window tonight and run extended replay tests. I'll coordinate with eng-runtime.

leah (SE): Customer channel updated, they acknowledged and asked for ETA. I told them we'll post a permanent fix ETA within 6 hours.

dylan (SRE): Handoff: night oncall will own follow-up. @nina you're up — keep the tenant pinned to v3.2-safe, watch for reappearance of eviction patterns, and escalate to ml-infra if errors exceed 2% or latency >2s sustained.

nina (oncall): Ack — taking ownership until 02:00 UTC. Added myself to INF-7821. Will validate canary traffic and keep daily checks.

maria (oncall): Thanks team. Marking initial mitigation complete. We'll draft a short post-incident note and schedule a deeper RCA with runtime + ml-infra.

incident-bot: NOTE: add "model variant pin" and "kernel rollback" as action items to INF-7821.

maria (oncall): Closing the active page for now; will reopen if metrics regress.
